Hymn 303: Keep the Commandments
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major

This is hymn number 303 titled "Keep the Commandments" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Barbara A. McConochie and the lyrics were written by Barbara A. McConochie.
